title: Running Errands
learning_objective: 能描述待辦事項、詢問服務時間，並調整辦事順序。

source.publisher: U.S. Department of State — American English
source.adaptation_notice: 依官方對話情境重新編寫語塊、句型、問答和完整對話練習；非原文逐字轉錄，也非官方 FSI 課程。

chunks.example: I need to stop by the bank.
I need to pick up a package.
I need to drop off a letter.
I'll stop by the store on my way home.
I need to get there before it closes.
Can we stop by the pharmacy?

substitution.instruction: 固定句型不變，只替換提示詞組。先說完整句，再核對答案。

items.answer: I need to buy some stamps.
I need to pick up a package.
I need to go to the bank.
I need to return a book.
I need to stop by the pharmacy.
I need to make a phone call.
I need to get a new key.
I need to drop off a letter.
I need to pick up my laundry.

buildup.instruction: 每次加上一段資訊，重新說完整句。

items.label: 取包裹
steps: I need to go to the post office.
I need to go to the post office to pick up a package.

items.label: 趕在關門前
steps: I need to go to the bank.
I need to go to the bank today.
I need to go to the bank today before it closes.

items.label: 安排順路
steps: I'll stop by the store on my way home.
I'll stop by the store on my way home to buy some bread.

transformation.instruction: 依照規則轉換句型，最後核對參考答案。

items.answer: I don't need to buy stamps.
Do you have time to go?
Does the bank close at five?

items.original: We have a lot to do.
items.answer: We don't have a lot to do.

items.original: She needs to return a book.
items.answer: She doesn't need to return a book.

items.original: We can stop at the store.
items.answer: Can we stop at the store?

response.instruction: A 問一句，你回答 B。相同對話三輪，逐輪加快。

pairs.a: What do you need to do today?
pairs.b: I need to pick up a package.

pairs.a: Can you stop by the pharmacy?
pairs.b: Sure, I can stop by after work.

pairs.a: Do you have time for one more stop?
pairs.b: Yes, I have a few minutes.

pairs.a: Are you finished with your errands?
pairs.b: Almost. I still need to buy stamps.

conversation.instruction: 先回應系統 A，再看 B 的參考答案。三輪提供不同的情境難度。

pairs.a: What are you doing this afternoon?
pairs.b: I have a few errands to run.

pairs.a: What do you need to do first?
pairs.b: I need to go to the bank.

pairs.a: Will you be home by six?
Can you pick up some groceries?

pairs.b: Okay, I'll stop by the supermarket.

pairs.a: Can you also get some stamps?
pairs.b: Yes, I'll go to the post office.

pairs.a: The pharmacy closes in ten minutes.
Do you still need to visit the bank?
pairs.b: No, I can do that online.

evaluation.notes: 不做自動語音辨識和發音評分；自評代表練習熟悉程度。
